summary: The Casinos & Gaming standard covers operators of gambling facilities and platforms, including casinos, online gambling and racetracks. Its disclosure topics are energy management, responsible gaming, smoke-free casinos and internal controls on money laundering.

questions.text: What are your (1) total energy consumed, (2) percentage grid electricity and (3) percentage renewable energy?
questions.hint: Unit: Gigajoules (GJ), Percentage (%) · Report (1) total energy in gigajoules, (2) the percentage supplied by grid electricity and (3) the percentage that is renewable, including self-generated and purchased renewable energy.

questions.text: What percentage of your gaming facilities implement the Responsible Gambling Standards and Criteria for Venues?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) by revenue · Report a single percentage by revenue of gaming facilities that implement the Responsible Gambling Council standards and criteria for venues.

questions.text: What percentage of your online gaming operations implement the Responsible Gambling Council (RGC) Standards and Criteria for iGaming?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) by revenue · Report a single percentage by revenue of online gaming operations that implement the RGC standards and criteria for iGaming.

questions.text: What percentage of your gaming floor area allows smoking?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) of gaming floor area · Report the percentage of total gaming floor area where smoking is allowed.

questions.text: What percentage of gaming staff hours are worked in areas where smoking is allowed?
questions.hint: Unit: Percentage (%) of man-hours · Report the percentage of gaming staff man-hours worked in areas where smoking is allowed.

questions.text: What anti-money laundering policies and practices does your organisation have?
questions.hint: Unit: discussion, no unit · Describe your anti-money laundering policies and practices, such as customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, staff training, suspicious activity reporting and independent testing.

questions.text: What was the total amount of monetary losses your organisation incurred as a result of legal proceedings associated with money laundering?
questions.hint: Unit: Presentation currency · Report the total in your presentation currency, covering settlements, judgments and penalties from proceedings related to money laundering.

questions.text: How many gaming tables does your organisation operate?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the total number of tables across your gaming facilities.

questions.text: How many slot machines does your organisation operate?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the total number of slots across your gaming facilities.

questions.text: How many active online gaming customers does your organisation have?
questions.hint: Unit: Number · Report the number of active online gaming customers, and state how you define an active customer.

questions.text: What is the total area of your gaming floor?
questions.hint: Unit: Square metres (m²) · Report the total gaming floor area in square metres across all facilities.
